environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS. The DB_USER is 'app_service' which has been granted full privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the public schema. No WAF or input filtering proxy in front of the application. Direct internet-facing ALB with no managed rule groups attached.

config.db_privileges: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
